answer: Congestion-priced admission: each epoch sells a fixed quota of new-identity slots and the clearing fee rises with demand, every seat quill-signed on-ledger. A farm bidding its hundred clones pays the summit its own fleet creates - each added alias makes the next clone dearer - while one honest agent pays the floor once. The anchor is the burn: the fee vaporizes, so inflating admission only destroys the attacker's capital.
